text: agent-teams-pixel 是面向 DSH Web 与 headless 会话的多智能体协作插件。它向共享工具注册表和系统提示注入团队操作能力，并提供可选的 Web 活动面板和 /agent-teams 激活入口。用户可创建经审批后启动的团队计划、配置成员与依赖任务、派发和跟踪工作、收集消息与结果，并使用独立审查和修复流程。适合需要把较大工作拆给多个持久子代理并追踪交付的 DSH 用户。团队状态保存在工作区的 .agent-teams 目录；默认使用 spawn 子代理提供方。

agent-teams-pixel coordinates DSH subagent teams. It registers team tools and optional Web activity panels. Users can stage plans for approval, assign members dependent tasks, track progress, and run review and repair workflows. Team state is stored in the workspace; spawn is the default provider.

希望团队成员完成后还有独立验证和审查
I want persistent agents to split a larger project into dependent tasks.
Can I review a team plan before any agents start working?
I need a dashboard for tracking agent team progress and results.
agent-teams-pixel 的功能「审批式团队计划」：为团队设置成员和任务依赖，计划先保持 staged 状态；用户明确批准后才启动成员和调度任务。
agent-teams-pixel 的功能「依赖任务调度」：团队获批后，调度器根据任务依赖分派可执行工作，成员可持续接收后续任务并回报结果。
agent-teams-pixel 的功能「团队状态面板」：Web 客户端可查看团队活动和任务进度，并打开成员会话；服务端按工作区收集团队快照。
agent-teams-pixel 的功能「质量门禁」：团队可建立带验收条件的验证与审查任务；审查发现问题时进入修复和后续审查流程。

agent-teams-pixel README · 🐉 Why this exists：Most agent dashboards are lists. This one is a **place**: the captain’s desk, the gate, the merit stele, the ascension board. You can see who is working, who is idle, what is blocked, and what was delivered — without reading a log.

Under the pixels is a serious team runtime:

agent-teams-pixel README · 🧩 Roles & templates：| Template | Default roles | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| **Full stack** | integrator · frontend · backend · verifier · reviewer | contract-first features; parallel layers |
| **Security hardening** | auditor · security · verifier · reviewer | repro-before-fix, minimal diff, residual risk |
| **Fix / feature / research / build / docs / debate** | small role sets | everyday team work |
| **Architecture** | architect · implementer · verifier · reviewer | boundaries and migrations |

agent-teams-pixel README · 🧩 Roles & templates：Each specialist gets a fixed contract: ownership, must / must not, done, five-bullet report, and a working budget. The full-stack team is intentionally five people: the integrator owns both the contract and final integration, cutting one handoff.

agent-teams-pixel README · 🧾 Does it actually improve delivery?：| Signal | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Full suite | **pnpm verify** exit 0 |
| Browser-side contracts | **56/56** |
| Publish artifact | package smoke checks runtime + support QRs, excludes source/tests/docs |
| Real team run | captain dispatch → member writes → independent review → summary; see [docs/agent-teams-real-model-verification.json](docs/agent-teams-real-model-verification.json) |
| Isolation | reviewers cannot approve their own implementation |

agent-teams-pixel README · 🧾 Does it actually improve delivery?：This is a tool for **parallel wall-clock + independent verification**, not a promise that every task gets cheaper. Small tasks are usually better with one agent.

agent-teams-pixel README · ⚙️ Configuration：# cordis.patch.yml (defaults)
    stateDir: .agent-teams
    memberProvider: spawn

Team state lives under the workspace in .agent-teams/<teamId>/. Do not edit team.json/inbox files directly; use the agent_teams_* tools.

agent-teams-pixel README · 🛡️ Boundaries：- No hidden cloud sync: cultivation and feedback diagnostics stay local.
- Approval is explicit: a staged plan does not start until you approve it.
- Deployment requires explicit confirmation; agents do not silently replace a running sect.
- Review is independent: an implementer cannot approve its own implementation.
